input.quote: 13.4 Other. All services provided hereunder, in addition to services subsequently requested by Corio (e.g. customization of the Software) shall be subject to the terms of a separate agreement between the parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" return only definitional, staffing and confidentiality/invention-assignment provisions (Section 13 Shared Resources, Section 14 Miscellaneous, Exhibit D Section 5 Personnel), none of which restrict either party from soliciting or employing the other's staff. Section 13, which governs Commerce One personnel seconded to work alongside Corio staff, ends at ownership/IP and covenant-not-to-sue terms with no personnel restriction. Accordingly nothing binds Corio (our client) not to solicit or hire Commerce One personnel, which matches the preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer. No redline required.
